title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings — Episode3 Affection From the Classroom

meta.Event Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Ichika told me that you've been acting strange lately. Did something happen? You can always ask me if there's anything that's bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line: Leave me alone...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: Why did you tell me to leave you alone the other day?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line: You haven't been reading my messages either. Have you been talking to Saki at all?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line: You know exactly what I meant by what I said...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Shiho
rows.Line: I don't have time to hang out with you or anyone else anymore.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (This is...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey, Honami! Want to walk home together?
There's a new bakery we could stop by on the way.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: Please don't talk to me at school anymore.
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Shiho and Hona haven't been around to visit lately.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: To be fair, this hospital is really far away...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: As lonely as I feel right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Shiho, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: I want to spend more time with them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (They all want to be together...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (How did this happen...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? That fragment...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Could this be...?
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The fragment became a SEKAI...
Oh, so this is a school SEKAI?
Yes, it seems that way.
Not only are there many classrooms here, the view from the rooftop was spectacular.
Wait, Luka, you've already had a chance to take a look around...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did you want to come with me, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, I'll let you know when I go for my next walk.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Again, it's okay.
I'll go look by myself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Ah, it's the residents of this SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Despite this SEKAI only being minutes old, they already seem to be fast friends.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, the feelings of the owners... The feelings of Ichika and the others are permeating all throughout this SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's clear that they desperately want to be together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope they come visit soon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So do I...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that may be difficult for them right now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Since they're avoiding seeing each other at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because they care for one another so much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope they discover their true feelings soon...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to head up to the rooftop, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, would you like me to come with you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No... I just want a breath of fresh air.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Have fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, this SEKAI really is overflowing with their feelings...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Between these matching plushies, this group photo and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Their instruments.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Everything here points to just how much they want to be together...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Their instruments in particular scream that.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Which tells me that they forged their bonds through music.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Even now, they're likely thinking quite a lot about one another.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I mean, their feelings for each other are so strong that they gave rise to this SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't want them to lose these feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Because they're so precious...
To them, nothing can replace them.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We have to do our best for them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So that they'll all discover their true feelings and smile like they did back when this photo was taken.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (She seems so reliable...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't worry. I know you can do it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your wish, as well as Miku's, will come true.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Those girls will discover their true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They'll make their dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please keep watching over them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did I just imagine that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, I shouldn't be acting all fidgety...
Especially since Ichika and the others may be coming over soon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We need to do our best for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So that we can guide them down the right path.

rows.Speaker: Movie
